Place Yi is located at the profile position in the right slightly upper-middle part of the figure. Observing the rock strata below place Yi, the stratum boundaries are continuously curved, and there is no obvious displacement like that of a fault; their form shows the middle part uplifted upward, with the strata on both sides dipping outward in an arch shape. Reasoning: When identifying geological structures, continuously curved rock strata belong to fold structures; in folds, rock strata that arch upward and whose two limbs dip outward are anticlines, while those that sag downward are synclines. Therefore the geological structure at place Yi is an anticline.

method.method_draft: 根据题干确定要求判断“乙处的地质构造”。先读图定位乙处，再查看乙处剖面中岩层的空间形态。乙处下方岩层不是断裂错动，而是连续弯曲，并表现为向上隆起的拱形，两侧岩层分别向外倾斜。按褶皱构造判读标准，向上拱起的是背斜，因此乙处的地质构造为背斜。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中为等温线及地质剖面块体图，标有甲、乙等位置。乙处位于图中右侧偏中上部的剖面位置。观察乙处下方的岩层，岩层界线是连续弯曲的，没有出现断层那样的明显错断；其形态表现为中部向上隆起、两侧岩层向外倾斜的拱形。推理：地质构造判读时，连续弯曲的岩层属于褶皱构造；褶皱中岩层向上拱起、两翼外倾的为背斜，向下凹陷的才是向斜。因此乙处的地质构造是背斜。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 地质构造判读规则：岩层向上拱起、两翼向外倾斜的褶皱为背斜；岩层向下凹陷、两翼向内倾斜的褶皱为向斜。

raw_record.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a block diagram of isotherms and a geological profile, marked with positions such as Jia and Yi. Place Yi is located at the profile position in the right slightly upper-middle part of the figure. Observing the rock strata below place Yi, the stratum boundaries are continuously curved, and there is no obvious displacement like that of a fault; their form shows the middle part uplifted upward, with the strata on both sides dipping outward in an arch shape. Reasoning: When identifying geological structures, continuously curved rock strata belong to fold structures; in folds, rock strata that arch upward and whose two limbs dip outward are anticlines, while those that sag downward are synclines. Therefore the geological structure at place Yi is an anticline.
